all_quotes.quote: We present the survey design, data reduction, construction of images, and source catalog of the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) twenty-six arcmin$^2$ survey of GOODS-S at one-millimeter (ASAGAO).
The primary goal of this survey is to obtain a census of galaxies with $L_{\rm IR} \gtrsim 3 \times 10^{11}$ $L_{\odot}$ or SFR $\gtrsim 50$ $M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$
Project code: 2015.1.00098.S, PI: K. Kohno
Project code: 2012.1.00173.S, PI: J. Dunlop
Project code: 2015.1.00543.S, PI: D. Elbaz
ALMA band 6 observations of the GOODS-S field were conducted in September 02–29, 2016
The center frequencies of the tunings are 262.56 GHz (1.14 mm) and 253.56 GHz (1.18 mm)
a spectral window (spw) was placed for each baseband with a bandwidth of 2000 MHz (15.625 MHz $\times$ 128 channels)
The observations were done in 37 execution blocks in the C40-6 array configuration
with a minimum baseline length of 15.065 m and a maximum baseline length ranging from 1770 m to 3247 m
a synthesized beam size of $0.59\ensuremath{''} \times 0.53\ensuremath{''}$
maximum recoverable scale of $\theta_{\rm MRS} \approx 1.2\ensuremath{''}$
$1\sigma \sim 30$ $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$ for a deep region with a 250 k$\lambda$-taper
The total observing time is 45 hours, and the on-source integration time is 29 hours.
conducted in September 02–29, 2016 for the Cycle 3 program
